rejected_charts.caption: FIGURE 1 - Crevice corrosion temperature (CCT) and critical pitting temperature (CPT) as a function of molybdenum content for several austenitic stainless steels. The numbers associated with the CCT data refer to alloys listed in Table 1, while the numbers on the CPT data denote the pitting families listed in the same table.
